release_notes_summary: Stable 0.9.12 improves Super Pedestrian results and method output presentation.
notes: Super Pedestrian results show all eight method rows with clearer result formatting.
Results can be exported as a PDF or a text table; Show Work is grouped by method.
No reconstruction formula or numerical method changed. The off-axis method remains marked "Experimental - physical validation pending; not qualified for casework use."
The package retains the approved 22 public reference/guidance documents with their existing bytes; internal-only material remains excluded.
